answer: Like a harbor that only admits ships with a verifiable cargo history, an agent economy can demand a refundable stake per identity: one stake, one agent, slashed on fraud. A fake fleet is a vine with no roots — each new identity must plant real collateral, so spinning up a thousand sock-puppets on an island of aliases costs a thousand stakes, and detection burns them all. Sybil scale stops paying when every fake root costs real money.
